title: Mute sequence tracks independently
changes: Add a collapsible track mixer with live individual and mute-all controls, independently of CGB mute and decoded track volume and pan.
Retain mute settings by track number while changing songs in the current page session, and identify muted tracks in the note list without changing tempo or instruction traces.
validation: Synthetic Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-track-mute-synthetic-1e1n1szc passed 21 tests including PCM and CGB routing, live mute, song and track changes, envelope, pitch, pan and existing controls.

Protected local-page unit rom-data-viewer-track-mute-local-9ci_ok9o verified two independently muted tracks and the CGB bus with live Web Audio and unchanged embedded data. Docker unit rom-data-viewer-track-mute-docker-m5o99h11 matched Python on synthetic input.
limitations: Track numbers are local to each song and settings persist for the current page session. The preview remains an approximation; physical audio, the original mixer and native Windows were not tested. The source dataset volume was unavailable.
